# Dublin Core

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A general-purpose metadata standard originally developed by librarians to capture metadata for publishing documentation on the web.

## Scope note

- Developed by the Dublin Core Metadata Initiative (DCMI), it includes core elements such as identifier, title, description, creator, date (created, modified, issues), subject, source, contributor, language, publisher, type, format, rights, and relation to describes resources of any kind across domains.
